subject.title: [Feature]: Telegram — full agent activity visibility (Web UI parity)

question: Should OpenClaw add a default-off persistent Telegram activity mode, and what disclosure, redaction, retention, and message-volume policy should it use?
rationale: The missing behavior is real, but implementing it changes Telegram disclosure and chat-retention semantics and likely adds config surface rather than repairing a narrow broken code path.

options.title: Add guarded Telegram activity mode
options.body: Implement a default-off mode with redacted summaries, bounded message volume, clear NO_REPLY/internal-turn exclusions, and tests/docs for sensitive output handling.

options.title: Keep current Telegram visibility model
options.body: Document preview/progress plus /verbose and /reasoning as the intended Telegram behavior and close this direction as not planned.

options.title: Keep detailed activity outside Telegram
options.body: Use Control UI or another observer surface for durable activity inspection and avoid retaining detailed tool telemetry in chat history.

recommendation.title: Add guarded Telegram activity mode
recommendation.body: Implement a default-off mode with redacted summaries, bounded message volume, clear NO_REPLY/internal-turn exclusions, and tests/docs for sensitive output handling.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans Telegram channel behavior, Gateway tool-event disclosure, and security/product policy; the timeline already routed maintainer attention to steipete.
